messages:
alex: Heads up — SDK PR #482 updates the client surface to include a new `streaming` param. This is blocking the console PR that calls the client. Need an approval timeline.

priya: Link? I'm around today; can review. Is this strictly breaking or additive?

alex: Additive, but the runtime change in api v2 removes the old endpoint. Console is still calling it, so we either need a small shim or coordinate merges.

cheng: @priya @hannah fyi helm chart also needs an image tag bump (runtime -> 1.13.0) because kv-cache fixes landed there. I can cut the helm patch if we schedule merge.

hannah: Can we do staged rollout? SDK + console can feature-flag `streaming` off by default. Roll runtime as canary first.

luke: @sre-oncall mentioned canaries were flaky in last run. @devops-bot what's the earliest we can open a canary? :eyes: 

devops-bot: deploy-bot: canary window available tomorrow 09:30 UTC if there are no blocking incidents. Automated smoke tests on main are passing.

priya: I'll pick up SDK review after stand. I can clear non-blocking comments quickly. Alex, please add a short migration note in the PR body.

alex: Done — added notes and a quick diff example:
```
- client.call('/v1/generate')
+ client.call('/v2/generate', { streaming: false })
```
Also added a test asserting the old path returns a 404.

cheng: For the helm bump, there's a values.yaml change (image.tag -> 1.13.0) and a small toleration tweak. I'll open PR and link it to both SDK and console. Helm PR will be #67.

hannah: Proposed merge order: runtime image -> helm bump -> SDK -> console. That ensures console CI runs against the new chart. Can we hold console merge until SDK is merged?

alex: Agree. Can someone add a `merge-block` label to the console PR until SDK is in?

luke: Adding `merge-block` and `merge-window:tomorrow-1000UTC` to console PR now. I'll also run the smoke tests after helm deploy.

priya: Review posted on SDK: small nits (import order, one comment on error text). Nothing blocking. Alex, address and ping me.

alex: Fixed imports and tweaked error message. PTAL.

priya: :thumbsup: LGTM — approving now.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2023-04-12 09:30 UTC — automated checks queued.

cheng: Helm PR #67 opened and linked to SDK #482 and console #991. I added `depends-on: [#482]` in the description.

hannah: I'll hold console merge until helm and SDK are green. Thanks for coordinating.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor the canary and will escalate on first sign of tail-latency >150ms. Ping me if anything odd during rollout.

alex: Thanks all — I'll queue merges in the order above and post updates here as each step completes.
